# The gate

## Narration

Ada carries the lantern through the gate (`[[rule:L1]]`) and is met by a
warden (`[[faction:wardens]]`, `[[location:keep]]`). The wick is already low.

## Dialog

@[[character:ada]] "The gate is open."

@gatekeeper "It opens for the lantern."

@[[character:ada]] "Then it stays barred to [[faction:wardens]]."
